name: Martin Timlin
bio: Martin Timlin signed the Medora Catholics' public thanks to the Marquise de Mores for building their church in December 1884, won the men's first prize at a skating contest in April 1885, and gave a wedding gift with Alice Morrison that August. In November 1886 a partnership he was in dissolved, and he kept the business at the old stand.
